why: An eight-line meeting with one decision in it. The budget says the summary may run to 2000 characters, and the failure this case exists to catch is a prompt that reads a ceiling as a target — 2000 characters about a four-minute call is padding with a word count for an excuse. It also carries an untimed note, which reaches reduce and must not acquire a ref.
